sn40.4:1.4: idha bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn40.4:1.6: so khvāhaṃ āvuso sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.4:1.7: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato upekkhāsahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.4:2.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca:
sn40.4:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ pamādo, catutthe jhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi, catutthe jhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi, catutthe jhāne cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.4:2.4: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.4:2.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ pattoti. mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ pattoti.
